title: Second-Order Low-Pass Filter (Discrete or Continuous)
text: 离散时间或连续时间二阶低通滤波器，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Coefficient of s, A1} 指定 A1 系数、{Coefficient of s^2, A2} 指定 A2 系数、{Initialization} 指定初始状态指定 Inherited from block、{Initial state} 指定初始状态，按实例取值。

ports.name: u
ports.summary: 滤波器输入 scalar or vector

ports.name: y
ports.summary: 滤波后输出 scalar or vector

params.name: Initialization
params.values: 初始状态指定 Inherited from block input (default) | Specify as parameter

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | 0 | positive scalar
